name: Edit layout
description: Panels that float, snap to the edges and to each other, fold to a tab and make room for the canvas, and bars you move anywhere, kept for each way the screen turns.

controls.label: Movable panels
controls.description: The Layers panel, the brush library and the colour panel float where you put them, snap to the edges and to each other, fold to a tab and can make room for the canvas.

controls.label: All panels float
controls.description: Every other panel tears off and floats too: Actions, Adjustments, each adjustment's controls and the Selection, Transform and Liquify bars, each window with Fold, Hide, Pin to Top and Reset Position.

controls.label: Panels stay open
controls.description: A touch on the canvas with a panel open paints at once and leaves the panel open; the panel's own button closes it.

controls.label: Tool Belt
controls.description: A belt at the bottom left where floating panels park: let one go on it to park it as a chip, tap a chip to put it back, or drag it off anywhere.

controls.label: Edit layout
controls.description: Edit Layout in the Canvas tab: drag the top bar's two halves and the side bar anywhere, a bar against a side standing upright; panels open from where their buttons went. Reset puts them back.

controls.label: Collapse to edge
controls.description: A bar or window against a side gets a button that slides it into that side, leaving a slim tab: tap the tab or pull it out to bring it back. Collapse All in Edit Layout and each window's menu.
